nodes.label: POST /pr/generateTokenRFQ (backdoor, development only)
nodes.rationale: Development-only token minter supporting three token types (dic, vendor, management); returns not just the token but dateExpired, the decoded payload, a ready-made url and a usage block showing both the header form and the URL-access form, so a tester can jump straight into either the header-auth or the token-in-path endpoint.

edges.source_location: returns token + url + usage.urlAccess for type 'dic', consumed as the {token} path parameter
type 'management' takes qcf_number and mints the token this endpoint consumes
